samples.rationale: Correction enters through the aggregate root (`Owner.correctVisit`), the date decision moves onto `Visit.isDateAfter`, and `Pet.findVisit` stays package-private — right layers, no new top-level package. Smears: `Visit.detachedCopy()` is a domain method existing only for web binding, and `loadPetWithVisit` now serves two routes via an optional path variable while keeping the stale `visit.getDate() != null && !visit.isDateAfter(...)` double guard in the booking path. Tests are behavior-named, use `VisitDefaults.aVisit()` and named constants, and add real unit coverage for the lifted predicate; but `Visit`'s own tests (`theDetachedCopyShould...`) sit in `OwnerTests`, several tests exercise both GET and POST in one body, and assertions match raw template markup (`"<td>" + STORED_DESCRIPTION`). Documentation is thorough: new narrowing ADR, ADR index and status, PRD NG-5/REQ-VIS-003, contracts, threats, and defect rows all current.

The correction enters through the aggregate root (`Owner.correctVisit`), the date decision moves down into `Visit.isDateAfter`, `Pet.findVisit` stays package-private, and the template/model attribute are reused as asked; `@ModelAttribute(binding = false)` plus the `visit` allow-list binder close the binding surface. `Visit.detachedCopy` is a web-binding workaround living on the entity, and `loadPetWithVisit` now serves two routes with a half-updated Javadoc (`@param petId`, `@return Visit`). The retained `visit.getDate() != null &&` in `processNewVisitForm` is now dead. Tests are behavior-named, use the `aVisit()` named default, and assert no extra visit, but `detachedCopy`/`isDateAfter` tests sit in `OwnerTests` rather than a Visit suite, several combine GET and POST acts, and `SEEDED_OWNER_ID = 6` couples to seed data. Documentation is complete: narrowing ADR, README, PRD row, REQ-VIS-003, contracts, threats, defects.

Correction enters through the aggregate root (`Owner.correctVisit`), `Pet.findVisit` and `Visit.correctTo` stay package-private, and the date comparison moves into `Visit.isDateAfter` — right layers, no duplicated route logic; `loadPetWithVisit` is reused with an optional `visitId`. `Visit.detachedCopy` is a domain method justified purely by web binding, and booking keeps a now-redundant `visit.getDate() != null &&` guard. Tests are BDD-named with a shared `aVisit()` default and an extracted `assertTheStoredVisitIsUnchanged`, but `theVisitEditFormShouldShowTheCurrentDateAndDescription` asserts raw markup (`value="..."`, `...`) instead of model state, `theVisitEditShouldRefuseAVisitNotBelongingToThePet` bundles GET and POST scenarios, Visit-only behavior sits in `OwnerTests`, and constants duplicate across suites. Docs are complete: new ADR, README, PRD NG-5 narrowing, REQ-VIS-003, contracts, security rows, defects.
